rules.name: Font family differs
rules.description: Text that plays the same role in peer elements uses a different font family.
rules.fix: Use the same font family as the peer elements.

rules.name: Font size differs
rules.description: Text that plays the same role in peer elements has a different font size.
rules.fix: Use the same font size as the peer elements.

rules.name: Font weight differs
rules.description: Text that plays the same role in peer elements has a different font weight.
rules.fix: Use the same font weight as the peer elements.

rules.name: Line height differs
rules.description: Text that plays the same role in peer elements has a different line height.
rules.fix: Use the same line height as the peer elements.

rules.name: Text colour differs
rules.description: Text that plays the same role in peer elements has a different colour, or is a link in one and plain text in another.
rules.fix: Use the same text colour and the same kind of element (link or plain text) as the peers.

rules.name: Text alignment differs
rules.description: Text in one peer element is aligned differently from the others (measured from the text itself).
rules.fix: Align the text the same way as in the peer elements.

rules.name: Inner padding differs
rules.description: The space between a container edge and its content differs from the same space in peer containers.
rules.fix: Give the container the same padding as its peers.

rules.name: Uneven padding inside one container
rules.description: A container has much more space on one side than on the opposite side.
rules.fix: Balance the padding, or remove the empty space.

rules.name: Uneven gaps
rules.description: The gaps between sibling elements are not equal, or the row gap and column gap of a grid are very different.
rules.fix: Use one gap value between these elements.

rules.name: Edges not aligned
rules.description: Peer content does not line up on the same edge: content inside peer containers, a title and the content below it, or a page title and the cards below it.
rules.fix: Move the element so that its edge lines up with its peers.

rules.name: Size differs
rules.description: A box whose size is set by the layout (tile, card, avatar, button in a row) has a different width or height from its peers.
rules.fix: Give the box the same size as its peers.

rules.name: Content inset differs between sections
rules.description: The content of one section starts further in from the section edge than the content of sibling sections.
rules.fix: Start the content at the same distance from the section edge as in the other sections.

rules.name: Not vertically centred in its row
rules.description: Items that sit in one row (icon and text, or values in columns) are not on the same baseline or centre line.
rules.fix: Centre the items on the same line.

rules.name: Peer columns end at different heights
rules.description: Columns or cards that sit side by side end at different heights.
rules.fix: Stretch the shorter column, or accept the difference.

rules.name: Table header not aligned with its column
rules.description: A table header does not line up with the cells of its column, or one column mixes alignments.
rules.fix: Align the header and the cells of the column the same way.

rules.name: Controls in one row differ
rules.description: Buttons, inputs and toggles in one row have different heights or uneven gaps.
rules.fix: Give the controls of the row one height and one gap.

rules.name: Odd element in a group of controls
rules.description: A group of buttons, toggles or tabs contains an element that does not match the others.
rules.fix: Remove the stray element, or make it a proper member of the group.

rules.name: Part missing in one item
rules.description: One of several repeated items lacks a part the others have, such as an icon or a label.
rules.fix: Add the missing part, or remove it from all the items.

rules.name: Divider stops short
rules.description: A divider or border inside one container stops before the container edge, while it reaches the edge in peer containers.
rules.fix: Make the divider run the full length, as in the peer containers.

rules.name: Corner radius differs
rules.description: A box has a different corner radius from its peers.
rules.fix: Use the same corner radius as the peers.

rules.name: Border or shadow differs
rules.description: A box has a different border or shadow from its peers.
rules.fix: Use the same border and shadow as the peers.

rules.name: Background differs
rules.description: A box has a different background colour from its peers.
rules.fix: Use the same background as the peers.
